Name: Baal-gad
ModernLocation: Valley of Lebanon, under Mount Hermon
Description: A town in the valley of Lebanon under Mount Hermon, named as the northern limit of Joshua's conquests from the smooth mountain by Seir.
BiblicalSignificance: Baal-gad is the far north of Joshua's map: from the southern hills to Hermon's valley, the land was taken town by town.
